When the user enters the username and password and clicks Login, the browser generates a request containing the information required to send the request to the appropriate server resource.

A request string is the URL generated by the browser or frontend to send a request to the server.
The browser generates the request string when the user performs an operation such as clicking Login or Register.

The resource path identifies where the request should go, while the form data contains information entered by the user.

Form data or UI data is the information entered by the user in a form.

The browser generates the request string. It contains the destination resource and the form or UI data entered by the user. The request is then sent to the appropriate server resource.

RAM provides the working memory required by the processor, while the hard disk provides permanent storage.

RAM provides a faster working area for the processor, while the hard disk stores data permanently.

Volatile memory is memory whose stored data depends on the availability of power.
RAM is volatile. Therefore, data stored only in RAM is lost when the power supply is removed.

18. What is the basic structure of a Java program?
A basic Java program contains a class, and the main method is placed inside the class.
19. What is the purpose of the main method in Java?
The main method is the method from which Java program execution begins.
The program logic is placed inside this method.

The class boundary is formed by the opening and closing curly braces.

27. What is the role of the operating system and command prompt during Java execution?
The command prompt provides a way to communicate with the operating system by entering commands.
The operating system provides the environment in which these commands are executed.

32. What is the difference between a Java source file and a compiled file?
contains the Java program written by the programmer.
The compiled form is produced after the Java compiler processes the source program and is used during execution.
A language processor is software that processes programs written in a programming language so that they can be executed by the computer.
Compilation is one form of language processing described in the source.
34. What is the difference between assembling and compilation?
converts assembly-language instructions into machine-level instructions.
converts a high-level programming language program into a lower-level form that can proceed toward execution.

object file in the C execution model described?

36. Why is linking required in the C execution model?
The source explains that after compilation, required library code may still need to
The linking process connects the required library contents with the compiled program.
A linking loader is software that performs two jobs:
It connects the required library contents with the compiled program and loads the required contents for execution.
38. What is an executable file in the C execution model?
The source describes an executable file as the completed file containing the contents required for execution after linking and loading.
39. Why is C described as platform-dependent?
The source explains that the compiled C program contains platform-specific information.
Therefore, a program compiled on one platform cannot directly execute on a different platform according to the execution model described.
40. What does platform mean in the platform-dependence discussion?
The compilation and execution platforms are treated as important
whether the compiled program can execute.
41. What problem was created by platform-dependent programming?
A program compiled for one platform could not directly execute on another platform.
For example, according to the source's model, a program compiled under Windows could not directly execute under Unix.
This created the need for a platform-independent programming approach.
42. Why was a platform-independent programming language needed?
A platform-independent language was needed so that an application could work across different platforms without requiring the same platform for compilation and execution.
This platform-independence requirement is the main concept introduced through the Java development story.
